chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said:

When you see the crescent, do not leave without saying: 'O Allah, I ask You for the good of this month, its opening, its light, its help, its blessing, its purification, and its sustenance. I ask You for the good of what is in it and the good of what is after it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in it and the evil of what is after it. O Allah, bring it upon us with security, faith, safety, Islam, blessing, taqwa, and success in what You love and are pleased with.'

key_terms.التَّقْوَى: God-conscious piety sought through the month
key_terms.التَّوْفِيقِ: divinely granted success in doing what Allah loves
key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: faith and inner belief asked for at the month’s arrival
key_terms.الْهِلالَ: the crescent marking the beginning of the lunar month
key_terms.بَرَكَتَهُ: its blessing and increase in divine goodness
key_terms.خَيْرَ: the good and benefit sought from Allah in the month

ai.seo_question: What should be said when seeing the crescent of the month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a du'a to be recited upon sighting the crescent, asking Allah for the good, blessing, purity, and sustenance of the coming month. It also seeks refuge from evil and asks that the month begin with security, iman, Islam, taqwa, and divine success.
